spec_gap: Inside `namespace App;`, an unqualified call to a global builtin (`strtoupper($s)`, no `App\strtoupper` in the scan): is the callee `strtoupper` (the runtime fallback target) or `App.strtoupper` (the namespace-qualified name as written), and is it low (a bare name not found in the scan) or medium (a statically named library function, as Python's `builtins.len` and Lua's `_G#pairs` are)?
notes: PHP resolves an unqualified function call in a namespace first as App\strtoupper, then falls back to the global strtoupper. SPEC gives PHP no builtin rule.
